$comment: Foundations › Word list and tests/copy.test.mjs read this file. `use` says what the word means as the back office uses it, `where` names the repo file that shows it, `avoid` lists words docs pages and screens don't use for it (the copy check flags them in docs pages). Facts come from the repo only.

words.use: The thing an admin sets up and residents take part in. It has a title, a status (draft or live) and one or more phases.
A group of projects with its own folder managers.
A group of projects across folders, the admin's newer view, with its own space managers.
One step of a project's timeline, with dates and one participation method. A phase is draft, live or done (ended).
What residents do in a phase: Information, Ideation, Survey, Voting, Proposals, Common ground, Document annotation, Volunteering or Poll. Say "method" for short.
What a resident posts in a phase, whatever the method: an idea, a proposal. The Input manager lists them all.
An input in an ideation phase.
An input in a proposals phase; it needs a number of votes to pass its threshold.
A resident's reply under an input. The team's own notes are internal comments.
A like, or a dislike where Disliking is on, that a resident gives an input (the Reacting to inputs action). Dashboards count them as Reactions; a phase can limit how many each participant has.
What the team posts on an input to say what happens next.
A person who lives in the place and may take part. The invented people in the demo are Resident A, Resident B…
A resident who has taken part in a project or phase; the count on dashboards and reports.
Someone who opened a phase; counted beside its participants.
Anyone with an account, as the Users page lists them, with a role: Platform admin, Space manager, Folder manager, Project manager or Registered user.
Short for Platform admin, the role that manages the whole platform.
A set of users, used to choose who can take part or who gets a message.
A theme a project or input is filed under, so residents can find it.
A part of the place a project is about; a project can have none or all.
Make a draft project live, so residents can see it.
Gone for good: a user, an input, a tag. It asks first, then offers Undo.
words.where: backoffice/src/pages/Users.tsx, docs/DECISIONS.md (Delete confirms in an Alert dialog)

words.use: Take something out of a place it sits in, while it still exists: from a group, a role.
Start and end a session.
The message and the address, one word.
A page of results built from blocks, read in order and shared.
A confirmation says what happened in plain past tense: "Page saved".
Say where the link goes: "Open the Input manager".
